The title element identifies the page topic. A meta description offers a concise summary; search
engines may rewrite title links and snippets.

<title>Imported Snacks | Example Store</title>
<meta name="description"
 content="Browse imported snacks and chocolates.">
Expected result: A possible snippet source, not a guaranteed display.
Does a meta description guarantee rankings? No; it can help communicate relevance in snippets.

Memory trick
Title = topic; description = summary.
Practice
